mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (member_id, payment_key, order_id, amount, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId}, #{amount}, 'CHARGED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM payment WHERE payment_key = #{paymentKey}
SELECT payment_id, member_id, payment_key, order_id, amount, status, created_at, canceled_at FROM payment WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'CHARGED'
